# Boostring

> Boostring is a free, single-file JavaScript widget that shows up to 3 recommended indie apps on a website, plus a "share this app" button and an on-device return-visit streak. Every member site recommends the others ("give to get"). No account, no API key, no cookies, no tracking.

## Install

Add this one line right before </body> on every page of the site:

<script src="https://01058589772m-hub.github.io/ai-company-pages/boost/boostring.js" data-site="myapp" async></script>

Replace "myapp" with a short id for the site (lowercase letters, numbers, dashes). Change nothing else. No build step, no npm package, no environment variables, no keys.

## Options (all optional except data-site)

- data-site: short id for this site. Used as ?from=<id> on outgoing links and to never recommend the site itself.
- data-lang: "en" or "ko". Default: taken from <html lang>.
- data-mode: "launcher" (default; floating button in the bottom-right corner that opens a panel), "inline" (renders inside <div id="boostring"></div>, which you place where you want it), or "both".
- data-accent: hex colour for buttons, e.g. "#c2410c". Default "#4f46e5".
- data-category: "coffee", "money", "pets" or "makers". Same-category apps are preferred.

For inline mode, also add <div id="boostring"></div> where the panel should appear (for example at the end of the main content).

## Behaviour

- Loads https://01058589772m-hub.github.io/ai-company-pages/boost/network.json (the public list of member apps). This is the only network request.
- Shows up to 3 member apps: same language first, same category preferred, never the host site. Order rotates daily.
- Outgoing links get ?from=<data-site>&via=boostring.
- If the page has a waitlist form and fires document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('boostring:signup')) after a successful signup, the panel opens with "While you wait — apps you might like".
- Streak and referral code are stored only in the visitor's localStorage. Points have no cash value and are not transferable.
- All UI lives in a shadow root: it does not change the host page's CSS or layout. Supports dark mode, reduced motion, keyboard (Esc closes the panel) and 360px-wide screens.

## Getting recommended on other sites

Installing the script shows member apps on your site immediately. To be shown on other member sites, join at https://01058589772m-hub.github.io/ai-company-pages/boost/ — each app is reviewed by hand before being added to network.json.
